description: This file defines the Perl module Mail::Address, which provides parsing and formatting functionalities for email addresses, including extracting names, hosts, and users from email address strings.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A class representing an email address, with methods for parsing, formatting, and extracting components such as name, host, and user.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor to create a new Mail::Address object with provided address components.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into Mail::Address objects, extracting address components.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats address components into a properly formatted email address string.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the display name from the address.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the host part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Mail::Address module.
